mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_llm_credential(user_id, ciphertext, iv, algorithm_version, key_version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ciphertext}, #{iv}, #{algorithmVersion}, #{keyVersion}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET ciphertext = EXCLUDED.ciphertext, iv = EXCLUDED.iv, algorithm_version = EXCLUDED.algorithm_version, key_version = EXCLUDED.key_version, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, ciphertext, iv, algorithm_version, key_version, created_at, updated_at FROM user_llm_credential WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_llm_credential WHERE user_id = #{userId})
